label.zh: 抵达三角定位出的陌生系统，击毁那里的卢瑟斯守卫舰队
label.en: Reach the unknown system found by triangulation and destroy the Lusus guard fleet there

bridges.evidence: infernals.115 (events/infernals_1_events.txt:1916-1990) creates the Lusus mining station (fleet flag lusus_miner_station) and the guard drones "Ancient Mining Drones"; the wrapper infernals.2150 (5522-5566) fires when a fleet with flag lusus_miner_guards is destroyed and sends infernals.2151 to the red giant player whose station is in that system

label.zh: 或者直接摧毁卢瑟斯采矿站
label.en: Or destroy the Lusus mining station outright

bridges.evidence: infernals.2120 (events/infernals_1_events.txt:4660-4780) fires when a fleet with flag lusus_miner_station is destroyed and branches to 2121 (before the station story is told) or 2122 (after it)

note.zh: 情势进度走满则恒星爆发为新星（infernals.50 → 51）；被成功逆转则恢复为温和红巨星（infernals.60）。互相替代。
note.en: If the situation progress completes the star novas (infernals.50 -> 51); if it is successfully reversed it returns to a mild red giant (infernals.60). These are alternatives.

note.zh: 2121 在尚未与居民交流前摧毁，2122 在了解其故事之后摧毁。
note.en: 2121 shows when the station is destroyed before its story is known, 2122 after.

notes.zh: 评注：红巨星起源的主线。游戏开始45天后（infernals.10 → 45）发出，并启动情势“红巨星膨胀”（五个阶段，进度走满则新星爆发，被逆转则恢复）以及事件链“红巨星”。四个选项选择最初的应对方式（对应情势的不同路线）。
notes.en: Commentary: the main line of the Red Giant origin. Fired 45 days after game start (infernals.10 -> 45), it starts the situation "Red Giant Expansion" (five stages; nova if the progress completes, restored if reversed) and the event chain "Red Giant". The four options choose the initial approach (different situation routes).

notes.zh: 评注：无论新星之后（51 → 12个月）、逆转之后（60）或稳定星体（2145）之后，都会在约12个月后引出这一事件“危机火花”。
notes.en: Commentary: this follow-up "A Spark of Crisis" comes about twelve months after the nova (51), after reversing the expansion (60) or after stabilising the star (2145).

scope.zh: 红巨星主线（情势五阶段、新星/恢复）、三角定位、卢瑟斯采矿站支线与摧毁分支均已核对；与 C1 的起源卡重叠。
scope.en: The Red Giant main line (five situation stages, nova / restored), the triangulation, the Lusus station arc and the destruction branches were checked; it overlaps the C1 origin card.

uncertain: Exact stage thresholds and approach effects were read from the situation definition but their pacing was not simulated.
The chance of the monthly infernals.95 trigger is the compiled 40% (monthly) estimate and was not independently verified.
